correctness.rationale: PASS: For K_n, an all-positive realizable support lies in a Hamiltonian cycle and is a linear forest unless the support itself is the full cycle. A spanning n−1-edge path fails a trace. Contract forced positive paths into blocks, avoid forbidden path adjacencies; for >=6 blocks Dirac degree bound applies, at 5 explicit complementary tour applies, and at 2,3,4 block cases determine exactly the singleton/long path or two-long-path exceptions. Exponential labeled-forest formula counts smaller supports and the two-path boundary counts the top coefficient, including n=3,4. Fresh direct exhaustive tour enumeration gave counts n=3:1, n=4:1+6z, n=5:1+10z+45z²+60z³, n=6:1+15z+105z²+375z³+360z⁴.
